text: Use Apache Ignite 2.18.0 with Java 17 source/target and add the required --add-opens JVM flags (java.base/java.lang, java.io, java.nio, java.util, java.util.concurrent, java.util.concurrent.locks, java.lang.reflect, java.net).
Bootstrap Ignite from Spring XML using either Ignition.start("ignite-config.xml") or by declaring an org.apache.ignite.IgniteSpringBean in the XML and fetching it via context.getBean(Ignite.class).
Call cache operations (getOrCreateCache, cache) on the returned Ignite instance, never on the static Ignition class.
The cache name argument must be a plain String literal, not an Ignite/IgniteConfiguration/ApplicationContext object.
Use modelVersion "8.0" in the initial configuration JSON, not the qpid-broker-core artifact version (e.g., do not use "9.2" for broker-core 9.2.1).
The AMQP port definition in the initial configuration JSON MUST include a virtualhostaliases entry with a defaultAlias, or client connections will fail to resolve the virtualhost.

Any virtualhost in the initial configuration that should accept publishes to not-yet-existing queues MUST have a nodeAutoCreationPolicies entry with pattern ".*", createdOnPublish/createdOnConsume "true", and nodeType "queue".
